_source: Derived from Nonet.dc.html. The Tokens screen (route 'tokens') is the authority; discrepancies with inline product values are listed in _discrepancies.
_discrepancies: type.control: Tokens screen says 11px/.13em. toolSty() renders 10px/.04em at 390. Per-viewport values recorded.

type.kicker: Tokens screen says 11px/.22em. The Solved screen header kicker renders 10px with .12em (390, 834) / .18em (1440) via L.kick + L.kickTrack. Tokens screen wins; the Solved kicker is off-token.
type.cell-digit: Tokens screen says 600 at 38px. cells() computes size*0.47 (18/36/38) and uses weight 600 only for givens; user entries render 400.
type.cell-note: Tokens screen says 15px/1.45. cells() computes max(9, size*0.185) over floor(size/3.6) = 9/10, 14/21, 15/22.
space: the Tokens screen publishes a 12-step scale, but the product mostly uses raw values off it. See space.offScale.
motion.reducedMotion: the Tokens screen prose says every duration collapses to 1ms; the stylesheet sets .001ms !important.
motion: pad keys use a 120ms background/border transition and archive rows a 120ms background transition. 120ms is not a motion token.
layout strip-cell: Tokens screen says 9/11/19 with gap 2/3/4. yearStrip() sizes the cell boxes 9/9/10 while the grid tracks use 9/11/19 — cells and tracks disagree at 834 and 1440.
layout tap-target-min claims 44 is never breached; grid cells are 39 at 390, banner Dismiss ~22, footer links 24, record year chips 28, record window tabs 40, settings Sign out 40.

contrast._method: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, measured from the hex values above. Ratios shown to 2dp.

raw._note: Colours used in the product that are not tokens. Each is a defect.
raw.link-default: #2C41C4 — a{} rule in <helmet>, equal to light --accent; does not follow the dark theme
raw.link-hover: #16181B — a:hover{}, equal to light --fg; does not follow the dark theme
raw.body-ground: #0E1113 — <body> and rootStyle background, outside the frame
raw.frame-edge: #22282B — box-shadow ring on the device frame
raw.focus-panel-border: #DEE1E3 / #23282C — hardcoded copies of light and dark --line2 on the Focus screen
raw.dev-switcher: #0E1113 #C9CFD2 #262C2F #6E767A #2E3437 #E9ECED #98A0A4 #93A6FF — harness chrome above the frame, not product

month-number.note: Archive month label. Not on the Tokens screen; recorded because it is a distinct step.

cell-note.note: Computed as max(9, round(cellSize * 0.185)) over floor(cellSize / 3.6).

mono-label.note: Also rendered at .12em, .14em, .16em and .2em in different places.

mono-data.note: Data rows in the product render 12/1 or 11/1 with no tracking — off-role.

chip.note: Not on the Tokens screen. Used by every chip (filter, input-mode, theme, year, jump). Distinct from mono-label only in tracking.

button.note: Not on the Tokens screen. Home hero buttons use 13px; dialog buttons 11px.

space._note: Published scale. The product uses it loosely — see offScale.

3px.where: home sparkline gap, pad-key internal gap (390)

5px.where: chip row gaps, mistake-dot gap, hamburger bar gap, drawer label padding-bottom

7px.where: legend swatch gap, merge-row gap (390), plate caption margin

9px.where: calendar cell padding, mistake dot size, space-token row padding, share-toast padding

10px.where: header gap (390), banner padding (390), calendar row margin, dialog action gap

13px.where: token, contrast and layout-constant row padding

16px.where: board header padding (390), list row padding, plate padding (390)

22px.where: drawer section margins, veil gap, About paragraph margin

24px.where: dialog scrim padding, settings row gap, solved stat padding-top

28px.where: dialog padding, solved stat column padding, button padding

30px.where: hero primary button padding, drawer primary label size

36px.where: rail padding-left, hero divider margin, solved stat gap

40px.where: grid-area right padding (1440), footer bottom padding, record stat margin

46px.where: plate padding (1440), solved share section bottom

48px.where: input and drawer control heights, howto column margin, settings account margin

52px.where: auth input and submit height, first-visit invite margin

56px.where: howto column gap, archive list row min-height (390)

64px.where: drawer primary row height, focus-panel cell size

easing.toast: 150ms in and out, no named curve

usage.motion-hover: Background and colour on outline buttons, links, rows.
usage.motion-place: A digit or a hint landing in a cell — scale .7 to 1, opacity 0 to 1.
usage.motion-reveal: The solved grid settling on the result screen — 7px rise, fade in.

reducedMotion._rule: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) sets animation-duration and transition-duration to .001ms !important on every element. The Tokens screen states 1ms.
reducedMotion.motion-place: No scale, no fade. The digit is simply there.
reducedMotion.motion-toast: Dwell is unchanged; it appears and leaves without a fade.

offToken.120ms: Pad-key background and border-color transition; archive list row background transition.
offToken.150ms: Calendar day box-shadow and opacity transition (matches motion-hover).

motion.unwired: motion-place is published and a nonetPop keyframe exists in <helmet>, but no element references it — placed digits and hints do not animate. state.hintCell is written and never read.

radius._note: No border-radius anywhere in the product. Every corner is square.

border.cell-thin: inset 1px var(--line) — between cells inside a box
border.cell-box: inset 2px var(--rule) — every third cell edge, and the grid frame
border.underline-active: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent) — nav link and drawer/year tabs
border.focus-ring: 2px solid var(--fg), outline-offset 2px (3px on nav link and primary button)
border.focus-ring-cell: inset 0 0 0 2px <ground>, inset 0 0 0 4px var(--fg) — drawn inside, because cells meet edge to edge

shadow._note: The only drop shadow in the product, on the confirmation dialog. The Tokens screen records it as '0 24px 60px 14%'. Not themed — the same black alpha in dark mode.

hatch._note: 45 degrees, 1px on 5px. The non-colour cue for a spent pad key.
